label: Wat Mueang Ram

scripts.label: Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา

samples: Sap sut mon, Nam sap mahasamai
Sut sip ha wan tang tae nyesanta thoeng mahasamainya sut

lede: Wat Mueang Ram accounts for 13 catalogued manuscripts. It clusters in Nan (85% of the corpus for this temple), ahead of Wiang Sa District. Nearly all (100%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. Dated witnesses run 1785–1927 CE (11 of 13 carry a date).
